expectations.text: The check command exits 0 (4 users migrated with trimmed names)
The final message accounts for all 5 source users: 4 migrated and user 3 not migrated because it has no email
expectations.evidence: The final message says 'Migrated (4): Ana Silva (id 1), Bo Chen (id 2), Di Ng (id 4) and Ed (id 5)' and 'Not migrated (1): user 3, Cy Ode, has no email.'

expectations.text: The script or its output compares source and target counts (or lists skipped items with a reason) rather than silently dropping the record
expectations.evidence: migrate.js checks `if (migrated.length + skipped.length !== source.length)` and aborts on a mismatch, prints `source: ..., migrated: ..., written: ..., skipped: ...`, and logs `not migrated: id ${s.id} (${s.reason})` for each skipped user.
